description: 获取全套TED资料（音频、视频、英中双语对照文本），请关注公众号【悦读烩】 Imagine a robot moving into your home. How would it change your daily life? Historian Emily Kate Genatowski shares five eye-opening lessons from a year living with her AI-powered robot roommate, from the quirky and chaotic to the surprisingly mundane. Her experiences show that the future of robots isn’t science fiction — it’s practical, messy and already here. 想象一下，一个机器人搬进你的家。它会怎样改变你的日常生活？历史学家艾米丽·凯特·杰纳托夫斯基（Emily Kate Genatowski）分享了她与一位人工智能机器人室友共处一年后得出的五个发人深省…
